name: RELION
summary: Cryo-electron-microscopy single-particle processing and reconstruction suite.

steps: Use the current official RELION installation guide and select its stable release branch rather than an arbitrary repository head.
Check compiler, CMake, MPI, FFT and optional CUDA/HIP/SYCL support; keep its Python environment distinct from the compiler/MPI build environment as instructed by the maintainer.
Build in a user-owned location, review detected libraries and GPU settings, and verify the resulting CLI/GUI without processing research images.
install.verify_note: Check the built RELION executables and official test procedure for the selected build; a reconstruction is a separate scientific validation.

notes: RELION is GPLv2 and free for academic and industry use; its optional external programs may carry separate terms.
